### Phylogenetic relatedness ###

We have 117 strains in our collection. As explalined in Guha et al., 2026, we created a variant calling format (vcf) file created with in-house strain AVT118. The vcf file has 96,206 SNP


## Doing a PCA with the SNP variants

I will open Sohini's recent vcf file created with the alignment to reference genome 118. This is the link: <https://github.com/sohini5981/AVT_SS/tree/main/Data> and the name of the file is strain_118_variants.vcf.zip

```{r}


vcf <- read.vcfR(here("Data_input", "Genome", "strain_118_variants.vcf"))

gt_reference <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT") ## 0 and 1
gt_reference

gt_numeric <- apply(gt_reference, 2, as.numeric) #"2" tells R to look at the data by columns, and "as.numeric" changes the text to other values into numbers
gt_numeric

rownames(gt_numeric) <- rownames(gt_reference) #Putting the names back
gt_numeric

## PCA needs one row per strain (observation), one column per SNP (variable). The current matrix is the other way around, so I will transpose it. 

gt_matrix <- t(gt_numeric)
head(gt_matrix)

dim(gt_matrix) ## It shows 117 and 1356566. # 

sum(is.na(gt_matrix)) #there are 762479 missing values ## handle the NAs because prcomp() can not handle NAs


complete_snps <- colSums(is.na(gt_matrix)) == 0 ## Returns TRUE for columns that have zero missing values, this is a way to filter and keep only the complete columns

gt_matrix <- gt_matrix[,complete_snps] ## Here I am retaining only the columns that do not have any missing data. 
dim(gt_matrix) # 117 and 96206

### Run the PCA

pca_result <- prcomp(gt_matrix, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE) 
summary(pca_result)

## screeplot


## scree plot: % variance explained per PC
pca_result$sdev 
var_explained <- (pca_result$sdev^2 / sum(pca_result$sdev^2)) * 100 #pca_results$sdev^2 represents the eigenvalues, and sum(pca_results$sdev^2) is the total variance across all PCs combines, which represents the total variance in the original datasets. These results are also the proportion of variace reported in summary(pca_results)
var_explained
#View(var_explained)

barplot(var_explained[1:10],
        names.arg = paste0("PC", 1:10),
        ylab = "% variance explained",
        main = "Scree plot")


## I will use the pc_scores
pca_result$x

pc_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)

pc_scores <- rownames_to_column(pc_scores, var = "Strain_Code")
pc_scores #PC1 and PC2 will be incorporated as fixed-effect variables in statistical models that indicate this



Strain_morphotype <- merge(Strains, pc_scores, by = "Strain_Code")
Strain_morphotype

### This file cointains the information about the phylogenetically relatedness, I will store it 

write_csv(Strain_morphotype, here("Tables", "PCA_scores_strains.csv"))

### I will merge this data with the morphology data to be able to color them based on "Morphology" 

Strains <- read_excel(here("Data_input", "Strains_Description_Phenotype_Github.xlsx"))
Strains

## Plot

PCA <- ggplot(merge(Strains, pc_scores, by = "Strain_Code"), aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Morphology)) + 
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mucoid" = "#4eadb9",
                  "Dry" = "#e0ba3e")) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[1], 1), "%)")) + #42.6
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", round(var_explained[2], 1), "%)")) + #17.6
  theme_bw()
PCA

ggsave(plot = PCA, here("Figures", "PCA.pdf"),
            width = 6, height = 2.5, units = "in")

```



### Co-occurrence ### 

I run an experiment using 4 pairs of strains, and co-inoculated them in 7 reps per plant. The alfalfa variety I used was Oneida. The pairs used were 091 - 101, 015 - 099, 016 - 100 and 029 - 098. The mucoid strains were 0.15, 029, 016, 091 and the dry ones are 098, 099, 100, 101. The pair refers to a co-isolated pair. I later selected 10 nodules per plant, sterilized them, crushed them, and streaked them. Then I observed whether the morphology the nodule was showing was Mucoid, Dry or a Mixture of both of them together. There should be around 70 nodules per Pair.

```{r}


Individual_nodule_data <- read.csv(here("Data_input", "SingleNodule_Ocurrence_data.csv")) #Create this file again I think I deleted it
Individual_nodule_data <- Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Morphology %in% c("Dry", "Mucoid", "Mixture")) #Remove contaminants and morphologies that did not have a clear morphology
#View(Individual_nodule_data)
### Create a table that shows the proportions of each morphology in the nodules 

function_pair <- function(Partner) {c(
  Name = Partner, 
  nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner)),
  sprintf("%.3f", 100*nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner & Morphology == "Mucoid"))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner))),
  sprintf("%.3f", 100*nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner & Morphology == "Dry"))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner))),
  sprintf("%.3f", 100*nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner & Morphology == "Mixture"))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner))))
}

Table_mix_percentage <- rbind(function_pair("091_101"), function_pair("015_099"), function_pair("016_100"), function_pair("029_098"))
Table_mix_percentage <- as.data.frame(Table_mix_percentage)
Table_mix_percentage

colnames(Table_mix_percentage) <- c("Pair", "Number of nodules", "% Mucoid", "% Dry", "% Mixture")

Table_mix_percentage

write_xlsx(Table_mix_percentage, here("Tables", "EPS_TableS1_FromR.xlsx"))

## Total number of nodules with mixture and with single 

## Total of nodules with valid assessment (taking out the contaminations). The results suggest that from 225 nodules, 83% have a single morphology, either mucoid or dry, wherease mixtures occupy around 17% of the nodules. The data broken down is in the upper part. 


## Plot

coocurrence <- ggplot(Individual_nodule_data, 
       aes(x = Name, 
           fill = Morphology)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_values)+
  labs(x = "Pair", y = "Proportion")+
    theme_classic() +

    text             = element_text(family = "Helvetica", color = "black"),

    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),

    panel.grid.minor       = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),

    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black")) 

coocurrence

ggsave(coocurrence, 
       filename = here("Figures" ,"EPS_FigureS2_FromR.pdf"),
```

### Exopolysaccharide description ###

Anthrone assay 

For the Anthrone assay experiment, I grew 116 strains of Sinorhizobium meliloti in RDM liquid media for 8 days. Then I centrifuged the samples, and recovered teh supernatant to run the anthrone assay, and resuspended the pellet in saline solution to measure the OD600 so I could normalize data to the OD600. 

```{r}

Oct2025_AnthroneOD620 <- read_excel(here("Data_input", "AnthroneOD620.xlsx"))

## Substract the Blanks labeled as "Bla" from the OD620 measurements. 

Anthrone620 <- Oct2025_AnthroneOD620 %>%
  mutate(OD620_Adj = OD620 - mean(OD620[Name == "Blank"], na.rm = TRUE))

## Calculate the amount of glucose produced by each strain using the calibration curve.

Glucose_standards <- Anthrone620 %>% filter(Morphology == "Calibration") ## Filter Morphology > Calibration 

Glucose_standards <- Glucose_standards %>%
  mutate(Glucose_quantity = case_when(
    Strain == "Glu1" ~ 20, #ug
    Strain == "Glu2" ~ 10, #ug
    Strain == "Glu3" ~ 5, #ug
    Strain == "Glu4" ~ 2.5, #ug
    Strain == "Glu5" ~ 1.25, #ug
    Strain == "Glu6" ~ 0.625, #ug
    Strain == "Glu7" ~ 0.3125, #ug
    Strain == "Glu8" ~ 0.15625, #ug
    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # Default case if no match is found
  ))


## I will extract the coefficients to make a formula and apply that to my current values 

model <- lm(Glucose_quantity ~ OD620_Adj, data= Glucose_standards) 
summary(model)

coefficients <- coef(model)

b_intercept <- coefficients["(Intercept)"]
b_intercept #  -0.2920703 
a_slope <- coefficients["OD620_Adj"]
a_slope #50.59358

## Filter out the Blank and the ones that have Glu but are not useful for the calibration

Anthrone620_strains <- Anthrone620 %>% filter(!(Strain == "Bla" | grepl("Glu", Strain)))
Anthrone620_strains                                                          

OD620_strains <- Anthrone620_strains %>% 
  mutate(Glucose_quantity = a_slope*OD620_Adj + b_intercept)

### Calculate the OD600

Oct2025_AnthroneOD600 <- read_excel(here("Data_input", "AnthroneOD600.xlsx"))

### MARIA DON'T FORGET TO MAKE THE CONVERSION AFTER ACCOUNT FOR THE DILUTION. ASK LIANA WETHER I should backcalculate. I am sure it will only change the absolute value. 

Anthrone600 <- Oct2025_AnthroneOD600 %>%
  mutate(OD600_Adj = OD600 - mean(OD600[Name == "Blank"], na.rm = TRUE))

Anthrone600_strains <- Anthrone600 %>% filter(Name != "Blank")

Anthrone600_strains <-  Anthrone600_strains %>% 
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(OD600_Adj_mean = mean(OD600_Adj)) ## Since I have two measurements per rep, I will find the mean od the OD600_Adj

Anthrone600_strains

### I will now merge the files 

Anthrone <- merge(OD620_strains, Anthrone600_strains, by = "Name")
Anthrone <- Anthrone %>%
  mutate(
    Strain = as.character(Strain),
    Name   = as.character(Name)
  )


Anthrone_complete <- Anthrone %>%
  mutate(Glucose_OD600 = Glucose_quantity/OD600_Adj_mean)
Anthrone_complete
#### Filtering ####

## Strain 121 did not grow in the RDM media, therefore I will remove them from the file 

Anthrone_complete <- Anthrone_complete %>% filter(Strain != "121")

write_csv(Anthrone_complete, here("Tables", "Anthrone_complete.csv"))


## Calculate the mean of each strain and not only of each tube (technical replicate)
Anthrone_mean <- Anthrone_complete %>%
  group_by(Strain, Morphology) %>%
  summarise(Glucose_OD600_ave = mean(Glucose_OD600))

write_csv(Anthrone_mean, here("Tables", "Anthrone_mean.csv"))

anova1

anova1
```

```{r}
#### Expand the "initial" values to the treatments ####

# I measured the initial values from the tubes inoculated with the Mucoid, Dry and Mixed population. The values were different between Growth and Survival, therefore I will divide them in two. 

### For survival 

soil_survival <- soil_data %>% filter(Condition == "Survival")


expand_survival_baseline <- function(data, morphology_value) {
  
  dat_morph <- data %>%
    filter(Population_Morphology == morphology_value)
  
  dat_no_initial <- dat_morph %>%
    filter(Timepoint != "0")
  
  initial_baseline <- dat_morph %>%
    filter(Timepoint == "0")
  
  treatments_to_add <- dat_no_initial %>%
    distinct(Treatment) %>%
    pull(Treatment) %>%
    unique()
  
  baseline_rows <- purrr::map_dfr(
    treatments_to_add,
    ~ initial_baseline %>%
      mutate(Treatment = .x, Timepoint = "0")
  )
  
  expanded <- bind_rows(baseline_rows, dat_no_initial) %>%
    mutate(Log10Total = log10(Total_CFU))
  
  return(expanded)
}


soil_survival
Survival_Mesocoms_Mucoid.expanded  <- expand_survival_baseline(soil_survival, "Mucoid")
Survival_Mesocoms_Dry.expanded     <- expand_survival_baseline(soil_survival, "Dry")
Survival_Mesocoms_Mixture.expanded <- expand_survival_baseline(soil_survival, "Mixture")

### Merge all the files Survival

Survival_Mesocosm.expanded <- rbind(Survival_Mesocoms_Mucoid.expanded, Survival_Mesocoms_Dry.expanded, Survival_Mesocoms_Mixture.expanded)

### For growth

soil_growth <- soil_data %>% filter(Condition == "Growth")


expand_growth_baseline <- function(data, morphology_value) {
  
  dat_morph <- data %>%
    filter(Population_Morphology == morphology_value)
  
  dat_no_initial <- dat_morph %>%
    filter(Timepoint != "0")
  
  initial_baseline <- dat_morph %>%
    filter(Timepoint == "0")
  
  treatments_to_add <- dat_no_initial %>%
    distinct(Treatment) %>%
    pull(Treatment) %>%
    unique()
  
  baseline_rows <- purrr::map_dfr(
    treatments_to_add,
    ~ initial_baseline %>%
      mutate(Treatment = .x, Timepoint = "0")
  )
  
  expanded <- bind_rows(baseline_rows, dat_no_initial) %>%
    mutate(Log10Total = log10(Total_CFU))
  
  return(expanded)
}


Growth_Mesocoms_Mucoid.expanded  <- expand_growth_baseline(soil_growth, "Mucoid")
Growth_Mesocoms_Dry.expanded     <- expand_growth_baseline(soil_growth, "Dry")
Growth_Mesocoms_Mixture.expanded <- expand_growth_baseline(soil_growth, "Mixture")

## Merge all the files for Growth: 

Growth_Mesocosm.expanded <- rbind(Growth_Mesocoms_Mucoid.expanded, Growth_Mesocoms_Dry.expanded, Growth_Mesocoms_Mixture.expanded)

## Now merge survival and growth 

soil.expanded <- rbind(Growth_Mesocosm.expanded, Survival_Mesocosm.expanded)


### Now calculate the average of the expanded data ###


soil.expanded_ave <- soil.expanded %>% ## Calculating the averages
  group_by(Name, Treatment, Population_Morphology, Timepoint, Rep_tube, Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    Dry_CFU_Total_ave   = mean(Dry_CFU_Total,   na.rm = TRUE),
    Mucoid_CFU_Total_ave = mean(Mucoid_CFU_Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_CFU_ave       = mean(Total_CFU,       na.rm = TRUE),
    Percentage_Dry_ave  = mean(Percentage_Dry,  na.rm = TRUE),
    Log10Total_ave = mean(Log10Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
soil.expanded_ave

  mutate(
    Condition  = "Survival",
    Timepoint  = factor(Timepoint,
                        levels = c("0", "3 months", "6 months", "12 months"))  
  )

#### Growth ####


popsize.median_Growth<- Growth_Mesocosm.expanded %>%
  group_by(Timepoint, Treatment, Population_Morphology) %>% 
  summarise(
    median = median(Log10Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    min    = min(Log10Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    max    = max(Log10Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

popsize.median_Growth <- popsize.median_Growth %>%
  mutate(
    Condition  = "Growth",
    Timepoint  = factor(Timepoint,
                        levels = c("0", "7 days", "14 days", "21 days", "42 days"))  
  )

## I will put together the data for the population size for both Growth and Survival: 

popsize.median_All <- dplyr::bind_rows(popsize.median_Survival,
                                       popsize.median_Growth)
```

```{r}
anova_Mixed_PercDry_Growth

anova_Mixed_PercDry_Growth <- anova_Mixed_PercDry_Growth %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Df$"), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))) %>%
  mutate(`Pr(>F)` = ifelse(as.numeric(`Pr(>F)`) < 0.001, "< 0.001", `Pr(>F)`)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-`Mean Sq`, P = `Pr(>F)`)

write_xlsx(anova_Mixed_PercDry_Growth, here("Tables", "EPS_anova_Mixed_PercDry_Growth_FromR.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
  dplyr::select(Treatment, Comparison, diff, P = `p adj`)





#### Compile the Anovas ####

Anova_Survival_soil_Treatments <- bind_rows(anova_Mixed_PercDry_Survival_22C, anova_Mixed_PercDry_Survival_32C, anova_Mixed_PercDry_Survival_DroughtC, anova_Mixed_PercDry_Survival_4C)
Anova_Survival_soil_Treatments

#### Compile the Tukey tests ####

Tukey_Survival_soil

Tukey_wide_Survival_soil <- Tukey_Survival_soil %>%

Tukey_wide_Survival_soil <- Tukey_wide_Survival_soil %>% select(Comparison, `diff_22 °C`, `P_22 °C`, `diff_32 °C`, `P_32 °C`, diff_Drought, P_Drought, `diff_4 °C`, `P_4 °C`)
```

############################################ 

### PLANT ###

Open the files 

```{r}

######## PLANT TRAITS ##################



### Data that contains the results from the single inoculation experiments that contains plant fitness data (shoot biomass) and nodule number

Host_data <-  read.csv(here("Data_input", "Single_Strain_Experiment_Host.csv"))
Host_data


### Find total nodule number 

Host_data <- Host_data %>%
  mutate(Nod_number = as.numeric(Nodule_LOBED) + as.numeric(Nodule_UN_Lobed),
         Prop_branched = as.numeric(Nodule_LOBED)/Nod_number)




####### RHIZOBIA RELATIVE FREQUENCY ######

### Data coming from the multi-strain inoculation experiments that contains rhizobial strain fitness

Freq_data <-  read.table(here("Data_input", "freq_100_AVT118.tsv"), header = TRUE, sep = "")

Freq_data <- Freq_data %>% 
  separate(col = pool, 
           into = c("AG", "Type", "Variety", "Rep"),
           sep = "_", 
           remove = FALSE, 
           fill = "right"
  )


Freq_data_MIX <- Freq_data %>% filter(Type == "MIX") ## Remove MC2

Freq_data_MIX <- Freq_data_MIX %>%
  mutate(Variety = if_else(Variety %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4"), "Initial", Variety))

Initial_Freq_data_MIX <- Freq_data_MIX %>% filter(Variety == "Initial")
Initial_Freq_data_MIX

Freq_data_NoInitial <- Freq_data_MIX %>% filter(Variety != "Initial") 
Freq_data_NoInitial

## Calculate the fitness 

Initial_Freq_data_MIX <-apply((Initial_Freq_data_MIX[,c(-1:-5)]), 2, mean) # The "2" specified that the mean should be found per column.
Initial_Freq_data_MIX
Freq_data_NoInitial
Sub_Freq <- Freq_data_NoInitial[, -c(1:5)]
Sub_Freq
normalized <- sweep(as.matrix(Sub_Freq), 2, Initial_Freq_data_MIX[colnames(Sub_Freq)], FUN = "/")
normalized

## Calculate the fitness

meso_fit <-as_tibble(cbind(Freq_data_NoInitial[,c(1:5)],log2(normalized))) #Find the log2 of the division and add back the information

## There are some that have a -Inf so I will replace it with -8

meso_fit <- meso_fit %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(. == -Inf, -8, .))) 
meso_fit


### Represent the values in the long format to be able to paste the values for Morphology 


meso_fit_long <- meso_fit %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Variety,Rep,pool, AG, Type, Variety, Rep),                    
    names_to = "Strain_Code",       
    values_to = "Fitness"            
  )
meso_fit_long


StrainFitness_Plant <- merge(meso_fit_long, Strains, by = "Strain_Code")
StrainFitness_Plant




###### FIND THE AVERAGES PER STRAIN AND MERGE THE FILES ######

## Find the average per strain in the plant trait file

Host_data_ave <- 
  Host_data %>%
  group_by(Strain, Variety, Morphology) %>%
  summarise(
    ave_shoot = mean(as.numeric(Shootweight_g), na.rm = TRUE),
    ave_root  = mean(as.numeric(Rootweight_g), na.rm = TRUE),
    ave_nod_total = mean(Nod_number, na.rm = TRUE),
    ave_prop_branched = mean(Prop_branched, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Host_data_ave

## Find the average per strain in the rhizobium relative fitness file


meso_fit_ave <- StrainFitness_Plant %>% 
  group_by(Strain, Variety, Morphology) %>%
  summarise(Fitness_ave = mean(Fitness))

meso_fit_ave

Host_ave <- merge(Host_data_ave, meso_fit_ave %>% select(-"Morphology"), by = c("Strain", "Variety"))
Host_ave

## Add the Phylogenetically relatedness file (PC1 and PC2) calculated earlier. 

Phylo_inf <- read_csv(here("Tables", "PCA_scores_strains.csv"))
Phylo_inf

### Merge the per strain average of the Plant Traits, rhizobia relative fitness and the phylotenetic information 

## Merge Host_data_ave and meso_fit_ave based on Strain_Code and on alfalfa variety 


Host_data_ave_all <- merge(Host_ave, Phylo_inf %>% select(-"Morphology"), by = "Strain")
Host_data_ave_all

write_csv(Host_data_ave_all, here("Tables", "Host_data_ave_all.csv"))

```

##### Plant benefit #####

```{r}

### Now I will calculate the shoot biomass   

Host_data_ave_all <- read_csv(here("Tables", "Host_data_ave_all.csv"))

### Figure: Host biomass ###

stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.3,position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +

HostBiomass

### Statistical analysis

hist(Host_data_ave_all$ave_shoot)

aov_hostbiomass <- aov(ave_shoot ~ Morphology*Variety + PC1 + PC2, Host_data_ave_all)
summary(aov_hostbiomass)

anova_hostbiomass <- anova(aov_hostbiomass)
anova_hostbiomass

anova_hostbiomass <- rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(anova_hostbiomass), var = "Term") #For table formating
anova_hostbiomass

## Aesthetics

anova_hostbiomass <- anova_hostbiomass %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Df$"), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))) %>%
  mutate(`Pr(>F)` = ifelse(as.numeric(`Pr(>F)`) < 0.001, "< 0.001", `Pr(>F)`)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-`Mean Sq`, P = `Pr(>F)`)

anova_hostbiomass
write_xlsx(anova_hostbiomass, here("Tables", "EPS_anova_hostbiomass_FromR.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
       device = "pdf",
       height = 3, width = 4, units = "in")



aov_hostnodtotal <- lm(ave_nod_total ~ Morphology*Variety + PC1 + PC2, Host_data_ave_all)
summary(aov_hostnodtotal)
anova_aov_hostnodtotal <- anova(aov_hostnodtotal)
anova_aov_hostnodtotal

anova_aov_hostnodtotal <- rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(anova_aov_hostnodtotal), var = "Term") #For table formating
anova_aov_hostnodtotal

## Aesthetics

anova_aov_hostnodtotal <- anova_aov_hostnodtotal %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("^Df$"), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))) %>%
  mutate(Trait = "Nodule number") %>%
  mutate(`Pr(>F)` = ifelse(as.numeric(`Pr(>F)`) < 0.001, "< 0.001", `Pr(>F)`)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Trait, Term, Df, `Sum Sq`, `F value`, P = `Pr(>F)`)

anova_aov_hostnodtotal
write_xlsx(anova_aov_hostnodtotal, here("Tables", "EPS_anova_aov_hostnodtotal_FromR.xlsx"))



#### Branching 

Host_Branching <- ggplot(data = Host_data_ave_all, aes(x= Morphology, y = ave_prop_branched, fill = Morphology)) +
stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.3,position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, fun.min = median, fun.max = median,
               geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6,
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.4,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
    geom_quasirandom(size = 1.2, color = "black", width = 0.25, alpha = 0.8) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = color_values) +
  facet_wrap(~Variety) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x= "Morphology",
    y = "Proportion of branched nodules"
  ) +
  theme(
    text             = element_text(family = "Helvetica", color = "black"),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.line        = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position  = "none")

Host_Branching
```

### Dual inoculation experiments ###

This compares pairs of mutants 

```{r}

Dual_inocualtion <- read_csv(here("Data_input", "Dual_inoculation.csv"))
#View(Dual_inocualtion)

Harvesting_results_RPM <- Dual_inocualtion  %>% filter(Pair %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4")) # Remove control and NA cells
Harvesting_results_RPM <- Harvesting_results_RPM %>%
  mutate(Pair = as.character(Pair)) %>%
  mutate(Colonies_Dry = as.numeric(Colonies_Dry)) %>%
  mutate(Colonies_Mucoid = as.numeric(Colonies_Mucoid)) %>%
  mutate(Percentage_Dry = (Colonies_Dry/(Colonies_Dry + Colonies_Mucoid)*100)) #One plate per plant
#View(Harvesting_results_M)

Harvesting_results_Dual <- Harvesting_results_RPM %>% filter(Morphology == "Dual")
View(Harvesting_results_Dual)  
                     
Dual_Competition <- ggplot(Harvesting_results_Dual %>% 
                                         mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))),  
                                         aes(x = Pair, y = Percentage_Dry)) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.3, color = "black", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), fill = "#e0ba3e") +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8), size = 2, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Pairs", y = "Percentage of dry bacteria") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text             = element_text(family = "Helvetica", color = "black"),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.line        = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black")
#    legend.position  = "none"
)

Dual_Competition


ggsave(Dual_Competition, 
       filename = here("Figures" ,"EPS_DualCompetition_FromR.pdf"),
       device = "pdf",
       height = 4, width = 6, units = "in")
```

### Shifts from mucoid to dry in plants 

```{r}

Harvesting_results_Mucoid <- Harvesting_results_RPM %>% filter(Morphology == "Mucoid")
View(Harvesting_results_Mucoid)


                     
Shift_InPlant <- ggplot(Harvesting_results_Mucoid %>% 
                           mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4")),
                                  Highlight = if_else(Percentage_Dry > 0, "red_dot", "normal")),
                         aes(x = Pair, y = Percentage_Dry)) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.3, color = "black", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), fill = "#e0ba3e") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Highlight),
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
              size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("normal" = "black", "red_dot" = "red")) +
  labs(x = "Pairs", y = "Percentage of dry bacteria") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text             = element_text(family = "Helvetica", color = "black"),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.line        = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position  = "none"
  )
```
